prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1034; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so we can address it.

We request that you disclose the full bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy that covers the vehicle involved, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with the declarations page in effect on the date of loss.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident. This includes photographs, recorded statements, claim notes, adjuster logs, vehicle inspection reports, repair estimates, surveillance or parking lot video, telematics or event data recorder information, and all correspondence with your insured and any third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your compliance with these requests.
